What is your return policy?
I'd be happy to help you with both!
For your existing order, I can connect you with our Order Status procedure to get all the details about your order — including status, tracking information, and shipping updates.
Our Return Policy varies by product type:
Mattresses & Toppers: Most mattresses come with a 1-year sleep trial (Eco Organic models have 100 days). You must try the product for at least 30 days before requesting a return. A $99 return fee applies to most mattresses.
Bedding & Pillows: 100-day return policy. Adult pillows allow 2 returns per household (since they're often bought in pairs), while other bedding items allow 1 per household.
Furniture & Bed Frames: 1-year trial with a 20% restocking fee. Items must be returned in like-new condition with no signs of use.
